wiki.title: Patricia Lundstrom
wiki.extract: Patricia "Patty" A. Lundstrom (born February 6, 1959) is an American politician and a Democratic member of the New Mexico House of Representatives representing District 9 since January 2003. Lundstrom served consecutively from January 2001 until January 2003 in the District 5 seat.
